basic_details.job_title: DLSA Pudukkottai Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Pudukkottai DLSA Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai, Tamil Nadu, for the selection of 20 Para Legal Volunteers. The recruitment is conducted under the legal services volunteer programme, inviting applications from eligible district residents interested in community service and legal awareness activities. Candidates must submit their completed applications offline by 24 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Pudukkottai DLSA Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications received after the prescribed deadline will not be accepted, as specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pudukkottai DLSA Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai, has invited applications from suitable candidates for 20 Para Legal Volunteer positions. The selected individuals will support legal awareness, community assistance and access-to-justice activities under the legal services programme.

content_sections.heading: Pudukkottai DLSA Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Para Legal Volunteer positions must be permanent residents of Pudukkottai district and willing to participate in social service activities. The notification invites applications from individuals belonging to several community, educational and professional backgrounds. Retired teachers, including teachers receiving pensions. Retired government employees and senior citizens. Master of Social Work (MSW) students. Anganwadi workers. Medical practitioners. Students, including law students, until completion of their studies. Members of non-political, service-oriented non-governmental organisations and associations. Members of women's self-help groups and recognised or marginalised community groups and organisations. Persons previously serving in legal services-related voluntary roles and eligible persons from other notified community-service backgrounds. Other individuals considered suitable by the District Legal Services Authority for Para Legal Volunteer service. Applicants must be permanent residents of Pudukkottai district. Candidates must be at least 18 years old. Applicants should be interested in community service and legal awareness activities. Applicants should be willing to undertake voluntary duties under the supervision of the legal services authority. The position is voluntary and does not confer the status of a government employee. The notification does not prescribe one common degree or minimum academic percentage for all applicant categories.

content_sections.heading: Pudukkottai DLSA Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official Para Legal Volunteer recruitment notification does not specify an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Pudukkottai DLSA Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai, will consider applications and conduct an interview for selecting suitable Para Legal Volunteers. Candidates whose applications are accepted will be informed about the interview process. Application Screening: Submitted applications will be examined for the prescribed eligibility conditions. Interview: Eligible applicants whose applications are accepted will attend the interview scheduled for 26 November 2026. Final Selection: Suitable candidates will be selected by the District Legal Services Authority based on the applicable volunteer selection requirements.

content_sections.heading: Pudukkottai DLSA Honorarium Details
content_sections.text: The Para Legal Volunteer position is voluntary and is not a regular government job. Selected volunteers will receive honorarium for eligible legal services work according to the applicable scheme and rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Pudukkottai DLSA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications using the prescribed form available on the Pudukkottai District Court website. Completed applications must reach the District Legal Services Authority by 5:00 PM on 24 November 2026. Completed prescribed application form. Educational qualification certificates. Age or date-of-birth proof. Aadhaar card or other valid identity proof. One passport-size photograph. Other supporting documents relevant to the applicant's eligibility, where applicable. The Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai – 622001, Tamil Nadu. Important: Applications must reach the authority by 24 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. Candidates submitting applications through registered post should account for postal delivery time. Candidates whose applications are accepted will be informed regarding the interview. Applicants should follow the communication issued by the authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many Para Legal Volunteers are being selected by Pudukkottai DLSA?
faq.answer: The District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai has invited applications from 20 persons to serve as Para Legal Volunteers.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Completed applications must reach the District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai by 5.00 PM on 24 November 2026; later applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: The applicant must live in Pudukkottai district and have interest and dedication for social service. Being able to read and write and having passed Class 10 is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: Teachers (including retired), retired government employees, senior citizens, MSW students, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students and law students, members of NGOs and self-help groups, law postgraduates, retired law professors, retired judicial officers, revenue officers and any other person the DLSA considers qualified may apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Para Legal Volunteer in Pudukkottai?
faq.answer: There is no salary; only an honorarium as per the rules of the Para Legal Volunteers Scheme is given.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from the Notification section of https://pudukkottai.dcourts.gov.in/, attach self-attested copies of the listed documents and send it to the Chairman/Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Pudukkottai-622001.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Para Legal Volunteers be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants will be selected through an interview on 26 November 2026 at 3.00 PM at the Mediation Centre office (ADR Building), Pudukkottai District Combined Court Complex.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says it is voluntary service and not a government job, and the declaration states the work is temporary with no right to claim permanency.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational certificates, an age or date of birth certificate, an Aadhaar card or residence certificate, and one passport-size photograph.
